book.name: Juanchi Caque
book.title: San Juan caque chuteca jun pila

content: Diosichi nalala
Seque meralaquede! Apa Diosi chiquilaca duque laquirato, yachi nalala jolajoe ticae. Junni tsanla joyoe. Junni uyanlari yaca miitotori, chiquilacanan miitolajochunae.

Nulaca laquirato payinayoe. Numa Diosichi nalala jolajoyoe. Juntonan Jesucristo manpatanasa niya quiraque jocaichunanque camiitolajoyoe. Incari miralarayoe: Ya quirainasa, chiquilanan yaca seque quirato, ya cuwentanan jocaichunaeque.
Jesucrístochi mantate tsanhino joyoeque tenca cato meralarayoe. Junni tsanque méraminlari ya cuwentanan seicala jochunae.
Jerale jutsa quiminlari Diosichi mantaca merátuminla joto, culpa talarae. Diosichi mantaca merátuminla jutsa quiminla joe.
Jesucristo jutsaca piyaribi patanueque, yari jutsa itoeque nulari miralarae.
Yaca telaquepotuto penenaminlari jutsa quede nenaminla itochunae. Jutsa quede nenaminlari yaca tsanle miitucala joe.
Junni nulari lachi nalala cuwenta meralaquede! Tencabe nenalarana! nene pánanunca quereituchun. Seque quimin tsachilari Jesucristo cuwenta sen tsachila jolajochunae.
Yucanni casalebi nechi jutsa quimin joe. Junni jutsa quimin tsachilari yucanchi jolajoe. Diosichi Nao mantimini yucan seiton suwacaca manse suwabi patanue.
Diosichi nalala itori, jutsa quito nenalaratuchunae. Tsachila Diosichi nalala jotori, yachi Apa Diosi cuwenta jolajochunae. Junni Diosichi nalala joto, jutsa quede nenano podeilaituchunae.
Tsanque miintsan jochunae mola Diosichi nalala jonunca, mola yucanchi nalala jonunca. Seque nenatuminlari Diosichi itolajochunae. Acolaca laquiratuminlanan Diosichi itolajochunae.
Laquiraminla
Beco beco laquiracaanola joyoe. Ya fiquica nulari casalebi nechi meracala joe.
Junni matu to Caín cuwenta itonola joyoe. Yari yucanchi joto, yachi acoca totenue. Yari seitonque nenasa, yachi acori seque nenamin jominue. Junnan yaca paito totenue.
Lachi acola, soquila, laca seque meralaquede! Diosica tennatuminlari nulaca pa jonari, wepanatulajona!

Chiquilari Jesucrístochi tsachilaca laquiralarayoe. Junbe miralarayoe Diosichi minuca nenalarayoeque. Puyano jonun minuca purato, sonnano jonun minuse nenalarayoe. Laquiratuminlari puyano jonun minuse canenalarae.
Uyanlaca pa jominlari tsachilaca toteminla cuwenta jolajochunae. Aman tsachilaca toteminlari numatotiya Diosibe sonnato polelaituchunae.
Jesucristo chiquilachi tenchi puyanue. Junnan miralarayoe ya tsa laquiramin joeque. Junni chiquilanan uyan Jesucrístobe penenaminlaca laquiratori, yalachi tenchi puyano patinari, puyanola joyoe.
Junni nulachi acola o soquila tinantiya itoto padeseinanunca miitori, ticatiya cuwanola jochunae. Diosi cuwenta laquiraminla jotori, acola ticatiya munaranunca mirato, cuwanilaquichunae.
Lachi nalala cuwenta meralaquede! Fiquichisiri laquiratulajona! Uyanlabe sen joto, tsa laquiralarana!

Tsanque nenatori miicaichunae tsarasi jonunca tenca cato nenaminla joyoeque. Junsi pansile chiquilachi tencabi culpa tenhicaichunae. Junni tsanque seque nenamin jomin jonan, chiquilachi tenca Diosichi cale pansi manjochunae. Diosiri chiquilachi tencaca fe joto jera mirae. Junni Diosiri jera miraeque tenca cato, chiquilachi tencaca manpansi suwano podeilaiyoe Diosichi cale culpa tenhituchun.
Junni amicola, chiquilachi tencabi culpa tenhitutori, Diosibe luracaituchunae.
Junni yabe luratuto, ticatiya cuwasa rocaino podeilaiyoe. Junni yachi mantaca meráto nenaminla jonan, ticatiya cuwasa rocainunca cuwaniquichunae.
Yachi mantá mantimini itsanque joe: Beco beco laquiracaato, yachi Nao Jesucrístoca quereintsan joe. Aman Jesucrístonan jun tsanquenan mantanue.

Junni jerale Diosichi mantaca meráminla yabe penenalarae. Yanan yalabe penenae. ¿Aman niyaito miintsan jochunan? chiquilabe penenanunca. Yachi Tencaca chiquilachibi ereca joe. Junca tenhito miintsan jochunae.
